description: Returns the full DESIGN.md for one AnimatedWebs website style reference (colour tokens, type scale, radius, buttons, layout notes, build prompt) plus a Tailwind v4 @theme block and CSS variables. Use it after search_catalog (kind styles) to build original work in that style; use get_template for a ready AnimatedWebs template. It is guidance only: do not copy the source site's logo, images, copy or trademarks. No credits, no pagination. Read-only. Unknown slugs return an error. Example: {"slug":"stripe"}.

slug.description: Style slug exactly as returned by search_catalog (kind styles), e.g. 'stripe'.

name: get_style_reference
title: Get an AnimatedWebs style reference
